source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Θεόκτιστος ο Οσιομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 797)» and holds one sentence, «Ο Όσιος Θεόκτιστος έζησε τον 8ο αιώνα μ.Χ. και ασκήτεψε στη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα. Κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 797 μ.Χ.» — he lived in the eighth century, was an ascetic at the monastery of St Sabbas and fell asleep in peace in 797. The day line calls him Οσιομάρτυρας, a venerable-martyr, while the page has him die in peace; the rank in the line is not recorded in `types` for that reason, and the discrepancy is left as the page's. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 797 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 797)», leaving the year of his birth a question mark.
